recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No follow-up is needed for the current core build unless a separate work item explicitly reopens legacy XPath or old-release schematron maintenance.
issue_request: FHIR-12759 was a Published DSTU2 MnM change request asking to change Timing.repeat.offset from unsignedInt to a signed number so offsets could be negative or positive. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected negative offsets as confusing with event codes such as before lunch and after dinner, and instead requested PHS, an offset invariant requiring when other than C/CM/CD/CV, and example updates.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11175, represented in git as 275544940db8c103d6e53cbd607e8dfc0edb38f3 (#12759). That commit added Timing event code PHS, strengthened the Timing.repeat offset invariant text and FHIRPath expression, and changed the meal Timing example from period/periodUnit to a positive offset with ACM.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini marks Timing as an active normative datatype. The current Timing source keeps offset as unsignedInt and uses the event code to determine before/after semantics; the linked Zulip discussion records the original signed-offset debate and terminology concerns. No Confluence Jira references or later exact Zulip key hits were found that would alter the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit would either contradict the final resolution by making offset signed or add redundant prose where the current authoritative source already carries the applied PHS code, invariant, and example semantics.
